brief:
Israeli security chief Gadi Eisenkot denounced settler assaults on electricity workers near the village of al-Mughayyir in Ramallah district, the Ma'an news agency reported. Eisenkot described the situation as a "routine of loss of control and chaos," pledging to end it within the coming weeks.

The attacks on power workers represent part of broader settler violence in the occupied West Bank, an issue Israeli officials have faced mounting pressure to address.

title: Eisenkot condemns settler attacks on power workers near Ramallah
